cases.inject: after an eligible preview and before command proof consumption, change RFC revision or any local/provider eligibility classification so current SOMA_RFC_HARD_DELETE_ELIGIBILITY_V1 no longer equals the reviewed fingerprint
cases.expect: HardDeleteRfc returns RFC_HARD_DELETE_PREVIEW_STALE when the target remains otherwise eligible but the exact reviewed fingerprint changed, or RFC_HARD_DELETE_BLOCKED when any current blocker/INDETERMINATE exists; both occur before proof consumption, receipt, audit or delete

cases.inject: LLD-04/05/07/09 classifier returns BLOCKED, INDETERMINATE, malformed output or raises while preview or writer revalidation is running
cases.expect: BLOCKED maps to the provider's closed dependency blocker; INDETERMINATE/malformed/exception maps to its closed indeterminate blocker; eligible=false and the writer never consumes proof or attempts dependent cleanup/delete

cases.inject: after all current eligibility checks pass, deliberate proof has wrong action, RFC target, base revision or eligibility fingerprint, or is expired/session-mismatched/already consumed
cases.expect: RFC_HARD_DELETE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with zero command receipt, hard-delete audit/result evidence or RFC mutation; client boolean/timestamp/challenge id cannot substitute for DeliberateActionProofV1

cases.inject: after valid proof consumption and command receipt/audit assembly, force unexpected FK/constraint failure, audit failure, exact-result persistence failure or failure immediately before commit
cases.expect: the one database UnitOfWork rolls back command receipt, hard-delete audit/result ref, command result and RFC delete so the RFC remains intact; the already-consumed proof remains unusable and retry requires a fresh deliberate action; no dependent row is deleted or rewritten
